The course is one sequence of days in nine parts, and every day comes after what it needs. You do
not have to take it from the top: pick the topic you want, and this page shows what it builds on
and an order in which to learn just that.

- **Click a day** (a box) to see everything it needs, highlighted in the graph, and a learning path
  on the right below the graph. The small bars inside a box are the day's units: click one to get
  the path to that unit alone, which is often shorter.
- **Search** for a topic, a method or a word from a title, e.g. *Fourier*, *watershed* or *Hessian*.
- A solid arrow means "needs" (a hard prerequisite); a dashed one means "see also" (useful
  background, not required). Zoom with the buttons or Ctrl + wheel, and drag to move around.

<link rel="stylesheet" href="demos/dist/demo.css">
<div data-demo="coursegraph"></div>

## All days as a list {#list}

The same content as the graph, as text. Each day names the days it needs; a unit that needs more
than its day says so. Links go to the lecture of a unit, with its quiz and exercise next to it.

### Part I: Images as numbers {#part-I}

#### Day 1: Images, filters and frequencies {#day-images}

**Needs:** nothing earlier.

**Topics:** image = matrix, affine transforms and homogeneous coordinates, interpolation; convolution and border rules; the DFT, convolution theorem, sampling and aliasing; PCA (2D picture, covariance, eigenvectors).

1. [Images as arrays & geometric transforms](images/lec.qmd) ([quiz](images/quiz.qmd), [exercise](images/exercise.qmd))
2. [Filtering & convolution](kernels/lec.qmd) ([quiz](kernels/quiz.qmd), [exercise](kernels/exercise.qmd))
3. [Images in frequency space](fourier/lec.qmd) ([quiz](fourier/quiz.qmd), [exercise](fourier/exercise.qmd))
4. [Principal component analysis](pca/lec.qmd) ([quiz](pca/quiz.qmd), [exercise](pca/exercise.qmd))

#### Day 2: Edges, blobs and ridges {#day-edges}

**Needs:** [Day 1: Images, filters and frequencies](#day-images).

**Topics:** Gaussian derivatives, LoG/DoG, Hessian, structure tensor, Canny, scale space; hysteresis (introduced inside Canny).

1. [Edges: Gaussian derivatives and Canny](canny/lec.qmd) ([quiz](canny/quiz.qmd), [exercise](canny/exercise.qmd))
2. [Scale space, blobs and pyramids](scale-space/lec.qmd) ([quiz](scale-space/quiz.qmd), [exercise](scale-space/exercise.qmd))
3. [The Hessian: blobs, ridges and saddles](hessian/lec.qmd) ([quiz](hessian/quiz.qmd), [exercise](hessian/exercise.qmd))
4. [The structure tensor: orientation and corners](structure-tensor/lec.qmd) ([quiz](structure-tensor/quiz.qmd), [exercise](structure-tensor/exercise.qmd))

#### Day 3: Bit depth and noise {#day-bitdepth}

**Needs:** [Day 1: Images, filters and frequencies](#day-images).

**Topics:** noise models, SNR, PSNR (cameranoise/); point operations, gamma/log, histogram equalisation, CLAHE, histogram matching, the cumulative histogram (contrast/); integer types and floating point.

1. [Quantisation and bit depth](quantisation/lec.qmd) ([quiz](quantisation/quiz.qmd), [exercise](quantisation/exercise.qmd))
2. [Camera noise, SNR and PSNR](cameranoise/lec.qmd) ([quiz](cameranoise/quiz.qmd), [exercise](cameranoise/exercise.qmd))
3. [12- and 16-bit images in practice](highbit/lec.qmd) ([quiz](highbit/quiz.qmd), [exercise](highbit/exercise.qmd))
4. [Contrast and intensity transforms](contrast/lec.qmd) ([quiz](contrast/quiz.qmd), [exercise](contrast/exercise.qmd))
5. [Floating point](floatingpoint/lec.qmd) ([quiz](floatingpoint/quiz.qmd), [exercise](floatingpoint/exercise.qmd))

#### Day 4: Image formation {#day-imageformation}

**Needs:** [Day 1: Images, filters and frequencies](#day-images).

**See also:** [Day 3: Bit depth and noise](#day-bitdepth), [Day 2: Edges, blobs and ridges](#day-edges).

**Topics:** PSF, OTF, sampling/Nyquist in optics, the forward model.

1. [Image formation and the point spread function](psf/lec.qmd) ([quiz](psf/quiz.qmd), [exercise](psf/exercise.qmd))
2. [Resolution, sampling and measuring the PSF](resolution/lec.qmd) ([quiz](resolution/quiz.qmd), [exercise](resolution/exercise.qmd))
3. [Running the model backwards: an ill-posed problem](illposed/lec.qmd) ([quiz](illposed/quiz.qmd), [exercise](illposed/exercise.qmd))

#### Day 5: Deconvolution {#day-deconvolution}

**Needs:** [Day 4: Image formation](#day-imageformation), [Day 3: Bit depth and noise](#day-bitdepth).

**Topics:** deconvolution (inverse filtering, Wiener, Tikhonov, Richardson–Lucy, blind); regularisation of inverse problems (data + λ·penalty, choosing λ, early stopping); the median as a denoiser; restoration artefacts.

1. [Linear deconvolution: inverse, Wiener, Tikhonov](deconv/lec.qmd) ([quiz](deconv/quiz.qmd), [exercise](deconv/exercise.qmd))
2. [Regularisation: what we add, and how much](regularise/lec.qmd) ([quiz](regularise/quiz.qmd), [exercise](regularise/exercise.qmd))
3. [Richardson–Lucy, 3D, and the PSF](richardson-lucy/lec.qmd) ([quiz](richardson-lucy/quiz.qmd), [exercise](richardson-lucy/exercise.qmd))
4. [Denoising and what you may measure](denoise/lec.qmd) ([quiz](denoise/quiz.qmd), [exercise](denoise/exercise.qmd))

#### Day 6: Splines and NURBS {#day-splines}

**Needs:** [Day 1: Images, filters and frequencies](#day-images).

**See also:** [Day 5: Deconvolution](#day-deconvolution), [Day 14: Labelling](#day-labelling).

**Topics:** spline theory (Bézier, B-splines, NURBS, smoothing splines).

1. [Polynomial wiggles, piecewise cubics and Bézier curves](bezier/lec.qmd) ([quiz](bezier/quiz.qmd), [exercise](bezier/exercise.qmd))
2. [B-splines and NURBS](bsplines/lec.qmd) ([quiz](bsplines/quiz.qmd), [exercise](bsplines/exercise.qmd))
3. [Interpolating, approximating and smoothing splines](spline-fit/lec.qmd) ([quiz](spline-fit/quiz.qmd), [exercise](spline-fit/exercise.qmd))
4. [Splines on images: interpolation and free-form deformation](spline-images/lec.qmd) ([quiz](spline-images/quiz.qmd), [exercise](spline-images/exercise.qmd))
